BerryBoot- bootloader running multiple operating systems on one card (or USB stick)

Berry boot allows you to run several operating systems on one SD card, and allows you to instal the operating systems to USB

this is good because the only time that the SD card gets used is at boot. SD cards dying is a big fault of the pi because SD cards aren't meant for the kind of read/write that an operating system requires. Fun things like overclocking also risks killing the SD card

I've yet to kill a SD card since using berryboot
